data.title: Request to confirm address abroad – Example Prairie Savings Bank
data.summary: Example Prairie Savings Bank (Customer Care – Accounts Abroad) asks Kwame Asante to confirm his residential address outside the US by completing an enclosed address certification form and sending it by January 15, 2027. If the form does not arrive, the bank will restrict online access to his account.
data.explanation: Your US bank must verify once a year that it has your correct address since you live abroad. You need to fill in the enclosed address certification form and mail or upload it by the stated deadline. If you miss it, the bank says it will limit your online account access until the form is received. If you have questions, you can write to them quoting the reference number, since the phone line will be down on one specific day in January.
